note: sha256 of the files shared verbatim with can-slim-recommend. Update ONLY in the same commit that ports the change to the sister repo.

pending_port.summary: Require a fresh data pull on every run
pending_port.why: Freshness policy is material: a screener ranking ideas off cached bars has the same defect as a grader. Port step 0, the data-guide freshness section, and the newest-bar / --stale-after check in chart_data.py (or its screener equivalent).

pending_port.summary: Grades must follow their evidence; strict pivot definition
pending_port.why: Both the pass/partial/fail discipline and the pivot rule (sound base AND new-high ground; no pivot >~10% below the 52-week high) are scoring rules the screener applies too.

pending_port.summary: 50-day average volume excludes the latest bar
pending_port.why: Only the chart_data side changed here, but the screener must use the same volume basis as relative_strength.breakout_volume wherever it reports a volume surge.
